cohort: The study included 50 mothers undergoing C-sections who were classified as ASA 1 or 2.
finding: In the Ephedrine group, patients experienced increased heart rates and frequently required repeat doses, whereas the Mephentermine group maintained a more stable heart rate and did not require incremental doses.
mod_finding: The study's findings are specific to the management of post-spinal hypotension during C-sections, comparing the efficacy of two vasopressors in this context.
